name: com.gamecore.gameplay.rewards
description: The narrative-to-card reward installation of 07 s5 (`NarrativeCardRewards`): the mounted installation that owns GC-021's reward bridge and a declared outbox state slot with a PreserveDormant last-support policy and a scratch-migration precondition of 'no pending work', so unmounting with pending work rejects through the job-fenced outbox resource lease until it drains, and the completed outbox is preserved dormant or handed to a named owner. It adds no kernel concept and no universal effect API.
